text:
It really is — you've got a solid foundation to work from now though. Get some rest, and when you're ready to pick it back up, we can tackle any of the sections that still need fleshing out (the room-by-room packing list, the 6–8 week calendar of phone reminders, or the printable moving-day one-pager). They'll be here waiting.

Sleep well, and good luck with the move!
